answer: Gate voting weight behind a 16-epoch work passport: each identity must complete four independently sampled jobs per epoch, and three of five established auditors sign the receipts. A clone that misses two rounds loses its 60 POA jade bond; wallets sharing funding or near-identical timing pay a bond that triples for every linked identity. The ledger verifies job hashes, auditor signatures, and funding ancestry, so a whisper of copied behavior becomes evidence rather than a relic hidden off-chain.
